products.title: IceBarrel Go
products.body_html: The Frostonic IceBarrel Go is your grab-and-plunge cold therapy solution—compact, portable, and fully functional. Designed for travel, tight spaces, and quick setups, it’s ideal for users who want the full benefits of cold immersion wherever life takes them.

products.title: Sauna Go
products.body_html: Recover anywhere with the Frostonic Sauna Go—an ultra-portable inflatable sauna that sets up in under 10 minutes. Durable, waterproof, and easy to control, it’s designed for powerful heat therapy at home or on the move.

products.title: Plunge Curve
products.body_html:
The Plunge Curve is engineered as a split-system, giving you the freedom to customize your setup and prioritize optimal comfort. The ergonomic design of this separate ice bath tub ensures full-body immersion and superior relaxation, while the detached chilling unit provides installation flexibility.

Note: The Plunge Curve requires a dedicated Frostonic PowerChiller for operation.

products.title: Plunge Edge
products.body_html:
The Plunge Edge is a split-system unit defined by its clean lines and modern, structured design. This separation allows you the flexibility to place the required Frostonic Chiller unit remotely, maximizing space efficiency in your dedicated recovery area. This robust tub offers a powerful, focused immersion experience.

Note: The Plunge Edge requires a dedicated Frostonic PowerChiller for operation.

featured_image.alt: side view of a  freestanding white acrylic ice bath tub, featuring a sleek rectangular design

products.title: Plunge Temp Checker
products.body_html: Keep your cold plunge safe and effective—this waterproof temperature checker lets you instantly track water temperature, ensuring your ice bath stays within the optimal range for recovery.

products.title: Infrared Sauna Blanket Pro
products.body_html:
Unwind and recover with the Deluxe Therapy Sauna Blanket. Made with non-toxic, flame-retardant PU leather and a 6-layer construction, it delivers safe and efficient far infrared heating. Lightweight, foldable, and waterproof, it’s easy to use, store, and carry—your personal wellness solution anywhere.

products.title: Ice Bath Tub Phone Mount
products.body_html: Stay connected while you recover. This adjustable, waterproof phone mount securely attaches to your ice bath tub, keeping your device safe and hands-free for music, calls, or guided sessions.

featured_image.alt: Black suction cup phone stand with adjustable arm and clamp for secure device mounting, stable base for versatile use.

products.title: PowerChiller Replacement Filter(0.3hp)
products.body_html: Keep your plunge water fresh and your system performing at its best. The PowerChiller Filter features a 20-micron filter engineered to trap fine particles—dirt, hair, and debris—down to 20 microns. By capturing impurities before they circulate, the filter helps maintain clean water and protects your chiller system.

products.title: AquaDeck
products.body_html: Keep it clean and safe. The Frostonic AquaDeck is a sleek, slip-free platform with an integrated water catch and 8-ft drain—perfect for a tidy, worry-free plunge.

products.title: Infrared Sauna Blanket
products.body_html:
Recover anywhere with deep, soothing far-infrared heat. A 6-layer build boosts safety and efficiency, the hands-free opening lets you multitask, and the fold-and-go design makes storage a breeze.

products.title: All-In-One Ladder
products.body_html: The All-In-One Ladder is the easy-access integrated Ice Bath Tub, designed with convenience in mind. The built-in safety ladder ensures effortless entry and exit for all users. Enjoy a powerful, hassle-free Cold Plunge experience with the integrated 1HP chiller.

products.title: Air
products.body_html: The Air is the essential round inflatable Cold Plunge Tub, designed for maximum portability and rapid recovery. Its classic shape allows for deep immersion, making it the perfect ice bath companion for travel.

products.title: PowerChiller Pro
products.body_html: The PowerChiller Pro is the high-performance 1.0HP unit, engineered for rapid cooling and continuous professional use. This powerful chiller is ideal for the largest cold plunge tubs, ensuring ultimate temperature stability and performance.

featured_image.alt: Black bath tub chiller with digital display, cooling fan, and wheels, designed to regulate water temperature in connected bathtubs.

products.title: PowerChiller
products.body_html: The PowerChiller is the compact and reliable 0.3HP unit, perfect for standard and portable cold plunge tubs. Enjoy consistent cooling and precise temperature control without the need for ice.

products.title: Air Pro
products.body_html: The Air Pro is the upgraded long oval inflatable Cold Plunge Tub, engineered for full body extension and superior comfort. Its spacious design ensures deeper immersion for a professional-grade ice bath experience.

featured_image.alt: A compact, black inflatable ice bath tub , designed for easy portability and versatile use in cold water therapy or relaxation routines.

products.title: All-In-One
products.body_html: The All-In-One is the ultimate intergrated Cold Plunge Tub, seamlessly integrating a powerful 1 HP smart chiller within its sleek shell. Enjoy precise, effortless temperature control and a minimalist design. Ideal for stepping or jumping in.
